_note: Plan 100053: five mutants covering coverage_verdict and the STATUS rename (thread 215, 2026-09-09).

mutants.name: M3-rows-must-equal-declared
mutants.why: Changing 'actual < declared' to 'actual != declared' means rows that EXCEED declared folds are treated as short (INCOMPLETE) instead of COVERED. test_rows_exceed_declared_is_covered expects COVERED when four rows are counted against three declared folds.

mutants.name: M4-highest-walk-judged
mutants.why: Removing the exclusion of the highest-numbered walk means the in-progress walk is reconciled. test_highest_walk_never_judged has zero w2 rows against four declared, so with the highest judged the verdict flips to INCOMPLETE.
mutants.anchor: completed = [w for w in declared_walks if w != highest]

mutants.name: M5-undeclared-becomes-covered
mutants.why: Replacing UNDECLARED with COVERED when the plan has no Draft: line would hide unresolvable plans. test_undeclared_no_draft_line expects UNDECLARED when neither --plan nor a Draft: line is present.
mutants.anchor: return ("UNDECLARED", "plan not resolvable: no Draft: line")
mutants.replacement: return ("COVERED", "plan not resolvable: no Draft: line")

mutants.name: M6-status-conformant-reverted
mutants.why: Reverting STATUS_CONFORMANT to 'CONFORMANT' means validate_file returns 'CONFORMANT' for a valid file and the stderr line says CONFORMANT instead of SHAPE-OK. test_stderr_line_format expects the SHAPE-OK token.

mutants.name: M7-panel-rows-counted-as-walk-1
mutants.why: Counting panel-* walk cells as walk-1 rows instead of panel rows causes them to be reconciled against w1's declared folds and inflates the walk-1 row count. test_panel_and_walk0_rows_counted_not_reconciled expects panel rows in the detail, not walk reconciliation.
